snippet.title: SALVAGE PROTOCOL - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
SALVAGE PROTOCOL is out today !
Get it now at : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3358680?utm_source=trailer

Salvage Protocol is a single-player horror game about infiltrating abandoned space stations. Break anything in sight, recover valuable components, dodge traps and fight off terrifying monsters hiding in plain sight.

You can also play our FREE demo at :  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3522930?utm_source=trailer
